# Player Dealt Damage

Source: [wiki article 4820](../archive/4820.md); edited 2024-11-26.

<a id="wiki-4820-n1"></a>

- Dealt Damage includes self-damage and checks rule conditions when the event occurs.

<a id="wiki-4820-n2"></a>

- Event Player and Attacker are the damage dealer; Victim is receiver (same as attacker for self-damage). Context includes Event Damage, critical hit, Event Ability and incoming Event Direction.
